x: Admittedly our line up for the '50' of seven starters included three who had never walked a '50' before - Eric Stroud, John Hall and Martin Yates - but where were the others?
However, we were still good enough for 2nd with Alan Lucas, Richard Tanner, Martin Lewin (who deserved a medal for determination) and Martin Yates as the four.
The other member of the scoring team was Martin Yates. He walked his best race in our colours and with a little more class racing he could develop into a good walker.
M.Yates was timed at 14:28 for 8th and R.Day 15:42 for 14th places. The Dunsford racing team led home our scorers in a 5km race at Downley on June 28th.
